𝗔𝗜 𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗲𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗲𝗮𝗻𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗮 𝗱𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿. Generative technology allows people to explore visual concepts, characters, environments and creative styles at a scale that was difficult to imagine previously. But creation is only one side of the equation. Ownership and provenance remain important components of the digital economy.

This is why the relationship between AI and NFTs deserves serious attention.

AI can support:

• Ideation
• Generation
• Iteration
• Personalization
• Creati
